intro: Research, writing, and design for biotech and health — from RNA-seq pipelines and survival models on Medicare claims to BCI signal processing, molecular dynamics, and prototype hardware. Most work starts with a conversation.

services.title: Research consulting
services.teaser: Literature synthesis, experiment design, signal & systems thinking.
services.detail: Scoped engagements from a single deep-dive memo to multi-week support. Pricing depends on scope — we align after a short intro call.

services.title: Technical writing
services.teaser: Grants, reports, and explainers that stay precise without going cold.
services.detail: Per document or monthly retainer. Clear milestones and revision rounds baked in.
includes: Grant sections, reports, and white papers

services.title: Design + prototyping
services.teaser: Interfaces, diagrams, and small interactive proofs-of-concept.
services.detail: Figma plus light front-end when it helps the story land. Milestone-based delivery.

process.title: Intro conversation
process.body: Share context, timeline, and what success looks like. No commitment required.

process.title: Scope & quote
process.body: I send a short scope doc with deliverables, timeline, and fixed or hourly pricing.

process.title: Delivery
process.body: Work in agreed checkpoints. You get drafts early; we refine before final handoff.

cta_body_contact: Use the contact form below — I reply by email, usually within a few days. Projects are scoped and invoiced after we talk.
cta_body_stripe: Use the contact form for custom scope, or pay for a defined offering via Stripe when you are ready.
cta_body_linkedin: Reach me on LinkedIn and tell me a little about the work. I reply within a few days. Projects are scoped and invoiced after we talk.
